```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: "Path to the directory containing agent markdown files"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ".continue/agents"

jobs:
  discover-agents:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.set-agents.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find agent files
        id: set-agents
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          if [ ! -d "$AGENTS_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Directory $AGENTS_PATH does not exist."
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Find all .md files, get just the filename without extension
          AGENTS=$(find "$AGENTS_PATH" -name "*.md" -type f | while read file; do
            basename "$file" .md
          done | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))')

          echo "agents=$AGENTS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  run-agents:
    needs: discover-agents
    if: ${{ needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents != '[]' && needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: npm install -g @continuedev/continue

      - name: Run Agent ${{ matrix.agent }}
        id: run-agent
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          AGENT_FILE="$AGENTS_PATH/${{ matrix.agent }}.md"
          
          echo "Running agent: ${{ matrix.agent }}"
          echo "File: $AGENT_FILE"
          
          # Run the agent using the continue CLI
          # Assuming the CLI supports running agents from a file
          # The exact command might vary based on the CLI implementation
          OUTPUT=$(continue agent "$AGENT_FILE" 2>&1) || {
            echo "::error::Agent ${{ matrix.agent }} failed"
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          }
          
          echo "$OUTPUT"
          
          # Save output for check run
          echo "output<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$OUTPUT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Check Run for ${{ matrix.agent }}
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: pull_requests } = await github.rest.pulls.list({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open'
            });
            
            if (pull_requests.length === 0) {
              console.log('No open pull requests found');
              return;
            }
            
            const pr = pull_requests[0];
            
            await github.rest.checks.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${{ matrix.agent }}`,
              head_sha: pr.head.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: 'success',
              output: {
                title: `Agent ${{ matrix.agent }} completed successfully`,
                summary: `${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.output }}`
              }
            });

      - name: Write Job Summary
        run: |
          echo "## Agent: ${{ matrix.agent }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.output }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
